hook_stat.sub: Consolidated net profit in Q2 FY27, up 28.7% year on year

stats.label: Net interest income rose year on year to Rs 13,335 crore
Gross NPA ratio, down from 1.24% a year earlier
Assets under management grew year on year to Rs 5,84,624 crore

diaspora_bullets: New loan bookings rose 11% to 13.45 million in the quarter
Customer franchise reached 128.85 million, up 16% year on year
news_summary: Bajaj Finance's consolidated net profit rose 28.7% year on year to Rs 6,366.57 crore in Q2 FY27, as net interest income jumped 24%.
payoff: The lender also proposed raising up to Rs 17,500 crore in capital, subject to approvals.
